readerCopy.body: A source of control can lose force quickly once the secret, threat, shame, money, or private rule behind compliance becomes explicit. When Pluto conjoins Lilith, power and refusal fuse, allowing buried anger to surface alongside the leverage that kept an unequal arrangement in place. The discovery can permanently change what people are willing to tolerate. Reversing the balance is most useful when it removes the leverage rather than recreating the same humiliation or control from the other side.
